lede: Select a KPI to inspect the canonical BigQuery view definition and a simulated top-facility extract. Replace `oaltc_raw.*` / mart references with your environment.

kpis.title: KPI 1: 30-Day Hospital Readmission Rate
kpis.description: Granularity: facility × month. Thresholds: ALERT >22%, WARNING >18% and ≤22%, ON TARGET ≤18%.
kpis.sql:
-- KPI: 30-Day Hospital Readmission Rate
-- Granularity: Facility × Month
-- Owner: Nursing Home Program Office

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW oaltc_kpi.readmission_rate_monthly AS
SELECT
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    region,
    report_year,
    report_month,
    COUNTIF(readmitted_30d) AS numerator,
    COUNT(*) AS denominator,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COUNTIF(readmitted_30d),
        COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS readmission_rate_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(readmitted_30d), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) > 22 THEN 'ALERT'
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(readmitted_30d), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) > 18 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'ON TARGET'
    END AS performance_status
FROM oaltc_raw.nh_discharge_events
WHERE data_quality_flag = 'PASS'
  AND discharge_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 13 MONTH)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5;
kpis.demoNote: Percentages and statuses follow the CASE logic in the view (notional demo rows).

kpis.title: KPI 2: Staff Turnover Rate (quarterly)
kpis.description: Granularity: facility × quarter. Illustrative thresholds: ALERT >35%, WARNING >25% and ≤35%, ON TARGET ≤25%.
kpis.sql:
-- KPI: Staff Turnover Rate (quarterly)
-- Granularity: Facility × Quarter
-- Owner: Workforce Analytics

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW oaltc_kpi.staff_turnover_quarterly AS
WITH headcount AS (
  SELECT
      facility_id,
      facility_name,
      region,
      fiscal_year,
      fiscal_quarter,
      COUNT(DISTINCT staff_id) AS active_staff
  FROM oaltc_curated.dim_staff_daily
  WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN quarter_start_date AND quarter_end_date
    AND data_quality_flag = 'PASS'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
exits AS (
  SELECT
      facility_id,
      fiscal_year,
      fiscal_quarter,
      COUNT(*) AS exits
  FROM oaltc_curated.fact_staff_terminations
  WHERE termination_kind IN ('VOLUNTARY', 'INVOLUNTARY')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    h.facility_id,
    h.facility_name,
    h.region,
    h.fiscal_year,
    h.fiscal_quarter,
    e.exits AS numerator,
    h.active_staff AS denominator,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(e.exits, h.active_staff) * 100, 2) AS turnover_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(e.exits, h.active_staff) * 100, 2) > 35 THEN 'ALERT'
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(e.exits, h.active_staff) * 100, 2) > 25 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'ON TARGET'
    END AS performance_status
FROM headcount h
LEFT JOIN exits e
  ON h.facility_id = e.facility_id
 AND h.fiscal_year = e.fiscal_year
 AND h.fiscal_quarter = e.fiscal_quarter;
kpis.demoNote: Turnover uses exits ÷ active staff for the quarter (demo numerators/denominators).

kpis.title: KPI 3: Falls with Injury (per 1,000 bed-days)
kpis.description: Granularity: facility × month. Illustrative thresholds (per 1,000 bed-days): ALERT >2.2, WARNING >1.4 and ≤2.2, ON TARGET ≤1.4.
kpis.sql:
-- KPI: Falls with Injury (per 1,000 bed-days)
-- Granularity: Facility × Month
-- Owner: Quality & Safety

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW oaltc_kpi.falls_injury_monthly AS
SELECT
    f.facility_id,
    f.facility_name,
    f.region,
    f.report_year,
    f.report_month,
    COUNTIF(f.injury_ind) AS falls_with_injury,
    SUM(c.bed_days) AS bed_days,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COUNTIF(f.injury_ind),
        NULLIF(SUM(c.bed_days), 0)) * 1000, 2) AS rate_per_1000_bd,
    CASE
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(f.injury_ind), NULLIF(SUM(c.bed_days), 0)) * 1000, 2) > 2.2 THEN 'ALERT'
        WHEN ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(f.injury_ind), NULLIF(SUM(c.bed_days), 0)) * 1000, 2) > 1.4 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'ON TARGET'
    END AS performance_status
FROM oaltc_curated.fact_falls f
JOIN oaltc_curated.fact_census_monthly c
  ON f.facility_id = c.facility_id
 AND f.report_year = c.report_year
 AND f.report_month = c.report_month
WHERE f.data_quality_flag = 'PASS'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5;
kpis.demoNote: Rate = injury falls × 1,000 ÷ bed-days (aligned to Section 3.3 pandas narrative).
